title: Apply RT occlusion from density shells in particle_mesh.frag
purpose: Use ray queries against shell TLAS to self-shadow the particle cloud efficiently on RTX.

steps.detail: Ensure mesh descriptor set has binding 3 = AS_KHR (already present).
In particle_mesh.frag, cast a ray from fragWorldPos along -lightDir with TerminateOnFirstHit|Opaque; if any hit, reduce lighting (e.g., shadowVis=0 or 0.2).
Add a runtime toggle 'rtSelfShadow' to enable/disable shell-based occlusion independent of external occluders.
Optionally skip queries for very low brightness fragments to keep cost low (early-out on alpha).

acceptance: Clear self-shadowing visible with shells enabled and RT toggle ON
No new validation errors; stable performance at target FPS
notes: Add softening/temporal (1008) after hard shadows are confirmed.
